name: opensrcer
description: Learn open source by fixing real issues: GitHub Copilot becomes your teacher, with each project's unwritten rules and a live code map.

opensrcer.url.description: The opensrcer site the tools talk to. Leave as is unless you run your own.

opensrcer.graphPython.description: Optional: a Python with graphify installed, to draw code maps on this machine. Empty: opensrcer draws them for you.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with opensrcer
walkthroughs.description: Sign in once, then ask Copilot to teach you an issue.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.description:
Create a token on the opensrcer site and paste it here. It's stored in VS Code's secret storage.
[Sign in](command:opensrcer.signIn)

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
Copilot runs opensrcer's setup check and says how to fix anything missing.
[Check my setup](command:opensrcer.checkSetup)

steps.title: Learn an issue
steps.description:
Name a project and an issue. Copilot teaches it step by step, and the code map opens beside your editor.
[Learn an issue](command:opensrcer.startLesson)
